name: Culligan MaxClear Gravity Water Filter
description: Culligan MaxClear Gravity Water Filter System - Microplastics, Lead & PFAS
features: THE ONLY GRAVITY FILTER CERTIFIED TO REDUCE MICROPLASTICS & TOTAL PFAS: Enjoy cleaner, safer drinking water with the ONLY gravity water filter system certified to NSF/ANSI 42 standards to reduce microplastics, lead, and Total PFAS (forever chemicals).

COMPATIBLE WITH BERKEY WATER FILTERS: Compatible with Berkey Black BB9-2 water filter replacement and other gravity filter replacements including Boroux, ProOne, Doulton, Purewell and Waterdrop filters.

UP TO 6 MONTHS PER FILTER: Unlike other gravity filters, Culligan MaxClear combines a durable ceramic shell with proprietary carbon media to reduce harmful contaminants, lasting up to 6 months per filter*. For faster and longer-lasting filtration, add up to 2 filters in your Scout system.

EASY SETUP & LARGE CAPACITY: No electricity or plumbing required. The high-capacity design means fewer refills, making it easy to keep the whole family hydrated – perfect for countertops, camping trips, and emergency preparedness.

DURABLE STAINLESS STEEL: This countertop gravity water filter dispenser features a sleek brushed or polished stainless steel finish, ergonomic spigot, and sturdy stand for easy dispensing. Nests under 12" when not in use.
